contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE ; D/ D N VALEN-S P F AVG

Copper alloy Nummus, Valens AD364-378. Mint: unclear, AD 364-378 (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads: SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE. Reverse: Victory advancing left holding wreath and palm. Obverse legend reads: D N VALEN-S P F AVG. Obverse: Pearl diademed bust facing right. Die axis: 12 o'clock. Weight is 2.68g, diameter is 17.42mm
